As a game designer, I've contemplated the true essence of gaming.

In this profit-driven era, we found ourselves entangled in the swamp of commercialized games. However, as time passed, we realized it wasn't what we truly desired. Pay-to-win games, the incredibly difficult designs forced for payments, and the seemingly futile efforts in the eyes of "whale players"... Can these truly bring joy to players? The clear answer is no.

After much contemplation, we decided to veer away from the wrong path. Thus, this anti-"pay-to-win" game was born at this moment. We transformed in-app purchases into a gaming experience. Players unlock features and all the game content that usually requires payment by cracking the game with the hacker, defeating the coercive power of the "pay-to-win" boss, and ultimately helping the game dev realize the meaning of true game design.
